story.summaryEn:
“I think today’s qualifying result is pretty disappointing. Our starting positions are challenging, but tomorrow – going into Turn 1, anything can happen." 🗣️ AK
Finishing off Saturday in Austin with Ayao, Ollie and Esteban 🇺🇸
#HaasF1 #F1 #USGP
detailZh:
"我认为今天的排位赛结果相当令人失望。我们的起跑位置具有挑战性，但明天——进入第1弯，任何事情都可能发生。" 🗣️ AK
在奥斯汀的周六结束比赛，与Ayao、Ollie和Esteban 🇺🇸一起完成。#HaasF1 #F1 #USGP
detailEn:
